name: 95129 · San Jose, CA
findings: ZIP 95129 (San Jose) has 200 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95129 (San Jose) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
